newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end higher in all months.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed higher across the board on Tuesday on light buying from local investors, who were encouraged by the yen's weaker tone against the dollar, traders said.
Prices were 40 to 90 yen higher and the benchmark September up 40 yen at 18,300. Daily volume was 29,182 lots.

Local investors could not find clear direction as the Chicago market was closed on Monday, the traders said. The yen's weaker tone, due to news that the U.S. launched cruise missile against Iraq, encouraged some investors in yen-based corn futures, they said.
The spot September contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.71-1/4 per bushel at 0857 GMT, against $3.70-1/2 at Friday's close.
The spot September of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $8.20 per bushel at 0857 GMT, from $8.14-1/2 from Friday's close.
